fact: A presidential decree read on national television on 7 January 2023 fixes the attributions, organisation and operation of the Institut Guinéen de Normalisation et de Métrologie (IGNM), a public administrative body under the industry and finance ministries, charged with drafting national standards or adopting foreign or international ones and publishing them; the document names no information technology or data standard.
